Let's Invest heavily onto the campaign
Let's Invest onto the campaign

I don't need to pay anything for campaign
Your loyal retainers are suggesting you go and make a speech to the public to boost your standing
Surely i can sway the public's hearts?
What they need is certainty.
Speech? I am sure the campaign funds can be used better elsewhere.
You are thinking of the ways to win the election when devious plan comes to mind, you could besmirch or otherwise sabotage other candidates in hopes for better election results...

Once each spring, it is allowed for all Amazons of any caste to mate with men so that new daughters can be born. Do you wish to host a fertility ritual, and put your captive male population to good use?
Yes, let the ritual be prepared!
No, maybe next year...

Rigg, Goddess of War and Battle does not normally tolerate men in her realm, but tonight her sister Serena will allow an exception. The drums beat, the pace of the dance increases, and as the wine flows, your ceremonial husband for one night is brought before you in chains along with many others for your gathered sisters. You may do as you wish with him and if he does not please you, the Snake-Goddess Serena will welcome his sacrifice after he has performed his final duty for the Amazon Sisterhood!
Come with me, slave...

While lying in the prison cell you hear the drums beat, the pace of the dance increases, the laughter upstairs in the palace grow increasingly wild as the wine no doubt flows. Fierce Amazon spearmaidens soon arrive to put you in chains and drag up to the hall along with the others. You are soon brought before an Amazon Priestess, and she leads you towards her private quarters... you have heard rumours that men who displease them during the fertility rites are sacrificed, so your heart is pumping out of your chest...
Must ... not... disappoint her!

You wake up with a smile on your face, sighing contentedly. The slave performed well last night, and you are inclined to let him live on. Yet on the other hand, Serena favours those who sacrifice in her name... especially things they place value on.
Another time perhaps. For now, this one lives.
A life for a life, Serena will have his blood!
You wake up with a sneer awoken by the slave's snoring, still tied to your bed. You remember his pathetic performance last night, and the blood lust begins to boil in your veins...
No, I'm going to be merciful.
At least I'll enjoy sacrificing this one, and hearing his screams.
You wake up tied to the Priestess's bed, and find her smiling down on you. 'Good slave,' she whispers, 'I hope the others let you live too, and I get you next year as well...'
Thank the gods, I'm going to live!

You wake up tied to the Priestess's bed, and find her sneering face looking down on you. Without a word, you are knocked unconscious by the hilt of a wicked looking dagger and when you come to... you are in the great hall, kneeling before the high priestess. Drums are beating, your head is pounding, Amazons are dancing and cheering behind you, and then a sharp cold pain is felt against your throat. You have no time to scream as the last things you see is a spray of blood pouring out on the ground from your throat!
Ugghhhh!!!

The sacrifices to Serena are brought before the throne. These men have proven themselves worthless. The drums are beating, your sisters are dancing around them, and cheers emanate from the sides of the great hall. Finally you step down behind the slave you bedded last night, savour the look of terror on his face, and then swiftly draw the sacrificial dagger as you move behind him and spray his lifeblood all over the floor. The Creators be praised, let this sacrifice please the Snake-Goddess!
Serena be praised!
Your top liege is an Amazon, and in Amazon realms men are forbidden from holding or inheriting titles unless they are a very rare exception.
Curse this unjust and purely socially constructed order!
Your top liege is no longer Amazon, so you can now inherit normally again.
Gender equality at last!
Maybe later.
Rigg's Favor
The Fertility Ritual
Lets do it again.
Lets do it.
Twins Have Been Born
Learning the Lore of Amazonia
Learn Lore of Life
Learn Lore of Beasts
The Fountain of Youth
Drink from the Fountain.
Drink from the Fountain.
Orders to cease fighting
Orders to cease fighting.
The Oak of Ages

As days go by, you've felt drawn closer to the heart of Athel Loren, the Oak of the Ages. You've finally embraced the call of the Gods and, as you enter the the ancient tree, you feel the benevolence and wisdom of Isha filling your very being. What happens later is indescribable, but when you've come out you've become more than a mere elf.

As days go by, you've felt drawn closer to the heart of Athel Loren, the Oak of the Ages. You've finally embraced the call of the Gods and, as you enter the the ancient tree, you feel the wrath and righteousness of Kurnous filling your very being. What happens later is indescribable, but when you've come out you've become more than a mere elf.
Let my enlightened guide shine over my subjects.
Let the Wild Hunt start anew!
Winter is coming closer and once again you feel the call of the Oak of Ages, to rest inside the heart of Athel Loren and wait for your forces to be renewed on spring.
Winter is coming closer and once again you feel the call of the Oak of Ages, to burn, die and be reborn from  the heart of Athel Loren in spring.
The summer is coming to an end and you feel more and more tired everyday. The call of Athel Loren compels you to yield to your torpor and sleep until the next spring.
So be it.
So be it.
So be it.
With the spring giving new life and color to the woods, you emerge once more from your sleep, reinvigorated by the power of Athel Loren, once more ready to defend it.
The Hunt draws close.

Something is wrong. You've awakened with a strange thirst for blood this year. The minds of all the Great Hunters are shrieking inside your mind, demanding for you to protect the sacred glades and slaughter all those who are planning to do harm upon them.
Blow the horns! It is time we hunt!
This year Kurnous has come back to life maddened with lust for blood. Already his call resonates over the glades, calling all the creatures of the forest to hunt, driving spirits and beasts insane.
Blreaaarh!!!
The horns pierce my ears!
What's all this ruckus about?
The Weave is out of balance. Day after day you hear whispers and shrieks beneath your bark, it becomes harder to focus, to keep calm.
Blreaaarh!!!

Athel Loren is not kind on those who fail to respect and preserve its boundaries. The branches and leaves twist and reach out by their own will and by the blink of an eye, part of your hold has disappeared.
What- where...?

Your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] has been plagued by nightmares and visions since [From.GetHerHim] angered the ancient spirits which roam within Athel Loren. The capricious forces of the forest have now decided to release their wrath against you as well.
Get away from me!

You search your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] for days, losing four more scouts to the treacherous forest, before finally admitting defeat. The terrible and ancient spirits of Athel Loren claimed [From.GetHerHim], your blasphemy has condemned your [GetFromRelation] to forever roam the timeless glades.
Why!?!

Your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] has been plagued by nightmares and visions since [From.GetHerHim] angered the ancient spirits which roam within Athel Loren. The capricious forces of the forest have now decided to release their wrath against you as well.
Get away from me!

After the third day of your [GetFromRelation] avoiding you, you finally manage to discover what was the cause of [From.GetHerHis] shyness. The spirits, angered by your actions, have carved their resentment into [From.GetHerHis] face.
This is... Oh-ugh!
Wondering in the woods of Athel Loren by yourself is not the most sensible action. Yet there you are, unaware of how or why did you leave the glade of your [GetFromRelation].
Where am I? Help!

You search your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] for days, losing four more scouts to the treacherous forest, before finally admitting defeat. The terrible and ancient spirits of Athel Loren claimed [From.GetHerHim], your blasphemy has condemned your [GetFromRelation] to forever roam the timeless glades.

Your young innocent [GetFromRelation] has disappeared. The cruel and terrible spirits of Athel Loren claimed what was more dear to you to punish you for your blasphemy, condemning the poor soul to forever roam the timeless glades.
No!
You awake in your bed, something rasping under the sheets. You cannot see nor touch your attacker, but at the same time you feel its cold claws pierce their way beneath your flesh.
Help!

You awake in your bed, something rasping under the sheets. You cannot see nor touch your attacker, but at the same time you feel its cold claws pierce their way beneath your flesh, searching for your eyes and your mouth.
Help!

You awake in your bed, something rasping under the sheets. You cannot see nor touch your attacker, but at the same time you feel its cold claws pierce their way beneath your flesh, breaking bones and maiming limbs.
Grlllbllch...

Wandering in the woods of Athel Loren by yourself is not the most sensible action. Yet there you are, unaware of how or why did you leave the safety of your hold. Voices whisper and a faint laughter echoes through the leaves.
Where am I? Help!

Your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] has been plagued by nightmares and visions since [From.GetHerHim] angered the ancient spirits which roam within Athel Loren. The capricious forces of the forest have now decided to release their wrath against you as well.
Get away from me!

You search your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] for days, losing four more scouts to the treacherous forest, before finally admitting defeat. The terrible and ancient spirits of Athel Loren claimed [From.GetHerHim], your blasphemy has condemned your [GetFromRelation] to forever roam the timeless glades.
Why!?!

Your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] has been plagued by nightmares and visions since [From.GetHerHim] angered the ancient spirits which roam within Athel Loren. The capricious forces of the forest have now decided to release their wrath against you as well.
Get away from me!
Your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] has been missing for some days. Many in the court have come to the conclusion [From.GetSheHe] has been taken by the spirits of Athel Loren.
It'll probably come back sooner or later...
You cannot sleep, you cannot think, the shrieking voices of the angered spirits follow your steps at every turn. As days pass by, you feel losing your grip on sanity.
Leave me alone! Alone!!

The spirits of Athel Loren are mysterious and capricious entities, all too ready to kill and twist any creature that dares entering their holy woods. You can only hope an offering could placate them, for some time.
A great offering for our friends.
The greatest gift for our friends.
I've changed my mind.
It is hard to read the forest's disposition, but as your offering vanishes, you can feel the Weave resonates with approval.
Excellent.
It is hard to read the forest's disposition. In a day, your offering has disappeared, but not sign has come from the spirits.
Hmm...

Your end has not come yet. Inflamed by your righteous anger, your spirit flew back to the heart of Athel Loren, to be reborn from the hulk of a deadwood as twisted Tree Kin, ready to exact vengeance upon your enemies.
Raahhh!!

It has become harder and harder to recall the memories of your previous life. The call of the forest is ever stronger and you feel your conciousness finally going away, merging with the Weave of the forest.
It has become harder and harder to recall the memories of your previous life. The call of the forest is ever stronger but you feel you could still maintain yourself apart from it.
It is time to join the Weave.
It's not my time yet!
You've stained your hands with the blood of Isha, such a blasphemous act echoes across the Weave, setting the spirits into a frenzy.
You've stained your hands with the blood of Kurnous, such a blasphemous act echoes across the Weave, setting the spirits into a frenzy.
You've stained your hands with the blood of a spirit, such a blasphemous act echoes across the Weave, setting the other entities of Athel Loren into a frenzy.
What have I done!?!
Bleaarrk'k'k'k!!!
[FromFrom.GetFirstName], one of the mysterious and treacherous Fair Folk, has taken hold of your [GetFromRelation], with no intention of ever giving [From.GetHerHim] back to you.
You've spent so much time within the magic and mysterious lands of the Elves, that it's hard to remember any other life.
Where I belong to?
Now that your ward is reaching adulthood, you've started to notice how the once delicate features of the child have started being spoiled by the obscene traits of [From.GetHerHis] lesser nature.
Send this thing back from whence it came.
I'm still fond of it.
You've brought your glorious host through the province of [From.GetName]. What should be done?
Let nothing stand in our way!
Tread carefully in these foreign lands.
The merciless riders of [From.GetTitledFirstName] have wrought destruction and ruin in your lands, destroying any building they came across and hunting down people like beasts.
Monsters!
The merciless riders of [From.GetTitledFirstName] have wrought destruction and ruin in [FromFrom.GetName], destroying any building they came across and hunting down people like beasts.
Monsters!
Pick the interesting ones.
The merciless riders of [From.GetTitledFirstName] have wrought destruction and ruin in your lands, hunting down the people like beasts, rounding up some of them and leaving in a magical mist.
Monsters!

The great and old [FromFrom.GetFirstName] has shown interest in your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName]. It's clear the spirit desires to drag [From.GetHerHim] forever in the depths of Athel Loren.
All, to our friends from beyond.
No, not [From.GetHerHim].
An old spirit from the depths of the forest has decided to honour your glade with its presence, bringing the might of its host to your defences.
And we graciously thank our new friend.
Your disrespectful attitude has angered on of the old spirits resting within your glade to the point of [From.GetHerHim] deciding to leave in disgust, along with [From.GetHerHis] host.
I'm so sorry!
An elusive and sombre group of Elves passed by one of your camps last evening, informing one of your captains that they will join your forces against a common enemy.
We welcome any help from our distant cousins.
Welcome, friends.
As if some small help will make us forget!
Who are these people?
The spirits have been deaf to your call. Nobody came.
They have abandoned us.
A host of saplings and dryads appears from the forest, rallying to your banners, ready to attack the enemies of Athel Loren.
Let us hunt together!
A host of spirits, led by old tree men appears from the forest, rallying to your banners, ready to attack the enemies of Athel Loren.
The Weave blesses us!
The summer has passed, and the spirits of your army start to fall to the torpor of winter.
No cell will hold you as long as the great forces of Athel Loren are with you.
The spirits freed me.
Trying to hold the Avatar of Isha herself while inside Athel Loren was folly: the goddess has freed herself with the help of a legion of angered forest spirits.
Trying to hold the Avatar of Kurnous himself while inside Athel Loren was folly: the god has broken out of your boundaries with a horde of angry spirits.
Athel Loren is deeply connected with the forest spirits. The one you tried to hold slipped away, welcomed by the very ground of its homeland.
Damnations.
Spirits attack the supply lines, soldiers are driven insane or just disappear into the wilds. It is clear your troops are not welcomed in the alien glades of Athel Loren.
The Weave allowed an old spellsinger to wander into your glade. The traveller has little memory of what brought them here, but they are ready to put themselves unto your service.
It's a sign. They are welcome.
It might be cursed.
All the children of Asuryan are connected to the Weave, but you've always felt a special link to the forest. Maybe your guardian could teach you to sharpen your senses and learn proper magic.
I'll be a wise Spellsinger!
For some time your [GetFromRelation] has bothered you, asking if you could teach [From.GetHerHim] how to link with the Weave and cast spells.
You could have some potential...
Get lost. This is not a game.
You've spent years on books of ancient lore, meditating in the depths of the forest, searching for a vision from the spirits, but to no avail. Your results in magic study has been less than mediocre.
No point continuing...
My [GetFromRelation] refused to teach you magic, claiming you've not the prerequisites to handle such a dangerous power.
I could! How could you say that?!

All in Athel Loren is about balance, summer and winter, death and rebirth, light and darkness. The endless cycles of the great seasons determine the existence of all beings. The Asrai understand the delicate nature of the Weave and do not shun from embracing all of its forms.
I will follow the lightened path.
I will follow the dark path.

The more time passes, the more it appears clear your student has decided to shun darkness and embrace the path of the Lightweaver, to heal the sickness and corruption that may tarnish the forest and preserve its pureness.

The more time passes, the more it appears clear your student has decided to shun light and embrace the path of the Darkweaver, to twist and instil terror upon those who would do harm to Athel Loren and threaten it's immaculate purity.
I'm proud of [From.GetHerHim].
That's... Still acceptable, I guess.
Your guardian has decided to take you as an apprentice and teach you in the ways of the Weave.
I'll soon be a powerful Spellsinger!

Spellsingers are the powerful magic-users of the Asrai. They tap into the Weave of Athel Loren and through this bond they can reshape the forest around them. After your long studies, you've been acknowledged as a learned mage of the Asrai people.
The forest speaks to me.
You've taught much of what you know to your [GetFromRelation] in the past few years and now you wonder if [From.GetSheHe] is ready to be recognized as a full mage.
The time has come.
Not really.
Your [GetFromRelation] has finally acknowledged, after many years of study, that [From.GetSheHe] is proud to call you a Spellsinger, no longer a mere apprentice of the arcane arts.
Yet there's still so much to learn...
There are many things that a mage-to-be should know to protect himself from the dangers of sorcery.
A Spellsinger should discern light from darkness.
A Spellsinger should always strive for perfection.
A Spellsinger should never lose his calm.
Let's just focus on magic.

In the past weeks you've spent several hours discussing with your [GetFromRelation] about how a Spellsinger should keep his mind clear and judge reality in an impartial way, so as to not be deceived by the corruption of Chaos or the lies of inferior beings.
Of course, it's objective we are the enlightened kin.

In the past weeks you've spent several hours discussing with your [GetFromRelation] about how a Spellsinger should always work at his best to perfect his art, study new spells, assure himself of correct ritual and so on.
I wouldn't want to blow up anything. By mistake.

In the past weeks you've spent several hours discussing with your [GetFromRelation] about how a Spellsinger should always keep his calm, lest his passion might cloud his senses and twist his spells against him.
But isn't passion that gives purpose to the Hunt?
You've lingered in the darkness for so long, its taint has started to obfuscate your senses, filling you with irrational hate and impure thoughts. Balance must be restored.
Light to compensate Darkness.
I shall endure nonetheless.

Your [GetFromRelation] is plagued by [From.GetHerHis] tidings to the dark powers. As a Lightweaver it is your duty to restore the balance of [From.GetHerHis] soul so that [From.GetSheHe] can continue to serve the forest.
I will prepare the ritual.

The ritual of [From.GetTitledFirstName] managed to tame your troubled soul. Once again the dark powers are entrapped and tied by your will, ready to be unleashed only against the enemies of Athel Loren.
And soon they will.

Despite [From.GetTitledFirstName]'s best efforts, you're still plagued by bloodied visions and twisted dreams. The dark powers you've always called upon to flay your enemies are now consuming your very soul.
I *will* contain them!

Whether through war or just the slow passage of time, the population in this province has fallen. Such is the fate of all elves in Ulthuan, to slowly diminish, but they will never yield to their enemies even so.

Whether through war or just the slow passage of time, the population in this province is now moderately depopulated. Empty villages and mansions dot the country side, their former inhabitants now only a distant memory.

Whether through war or just the slow passage of time, the population in this province is now heavily depopulated. The lords there struggle to maintain a semblance of civilization, and many areas are now devoid of elves entirely, given over to nature and the wild beasts.

Whether through war or just the slow passage of time, the population in this province is now severely depopulated. The major noble families still maintain their mansions and the immediate surrounds, but they have lost the ability to control much more than that.
This province is occupied by enemies and many precious elven lives have been lost.
I could have done just as well.
While on a border patrol, one of your courtiers defeated a band of raiders, almost single-handedly driving them off. [From.GetSheHeCap] is hailed as a great warrior by all in the court.

While on a border patrol, a courtier's small force was ambushed, but [From.GetSheHe] fled and left [From.GetHerHis] men to die! [From.GetHerHisCap] name is in disgrace, and [From.GetSheHe] has shamed our entire court with [From.GetHerHis] cowardice.
It reminds me of the first light of a winter moon!
It reminds me of the first light of a winter moon!

This courtier has composed a stunning new epic, which brings tears to the eyes of anyone who hears it. At the feast table, even hardened warriors are seen with misty eyes, reminiscing of the glories of your ancient race.
No, I think I'll sit this one out.

Foul creatures such as manticores and hydras sometimes make their way down from the Anulii mountains. Your huntmaster is arranging a great hunt, do you wish to join in it and perhaps win a new trophy for the walls of your feast hall?
Who am I to go against tradition?

While the Phoenix King is the political centre of Ulthuan, the Everqueen is its spiritual heart. It is tradition that they have a year-long ritual marriage and produce a daughter who shall be the next Everqueen.
Who am I to stand against tradition?

While the Phoenix King is the political centre of Ulthuan, the Everqueen is its spiritual heart. It is tradition that they have a year-long ritual marriage and produce a daughter who shall be the next Everqueen.
Dear wife, I thought of Ulthuan the whole time!
You travel swiftly to Avelorn, where you spend many days and nights with the Everqueen. She assures you that her magic will guarantee that a child will be born shortly - the new future Everqueen.
I knew it was going to be a girl!
Nine months after the visit from the Phoenix King, a child is born. Avelorn rejoices at the birth of its future Everqueen!
She will be a great Everqueen one day.
Word reaches you that all of Avelorn and Ulthuan rejoice - a new Everqueen has been born, you have fathered a beautiful daughter!
The priestesses make sure you are ready by casting the proper protective spells, and you leap into the flames that will consecrate you as the rightful ruler of Ulthuan.
May Asuryan judge me well.
You emerge unscathed from the holy flames, the priestesses raise their praises to the Gods and the new Phoenix King.
Asuryan blesses me.

You enter the flames with a steady heart, but the Gods do not favour you today. Asuryan's gaze passes through your protective spells and your flesh is scourged with fire. The priestesses manage to recover you, shrieking and maimed, but the will of the Gods has been made clear today, you are not the rightful heir to the Phoenix Crown.
AAAARGH!

You enter the flames with a steady heart, but the Gods do not favour you today. Asuryan's gaze passes through your protective spells and your flesh is scourged with fire. The priestesses struggle to save you, but your offences must have been great indeed, for they recover nothing but a blackened carcass.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] has passed through the Flames of Asuryan without being burned, thus proving his divinely-given right to rule over Ulthuan.
Long live the Phoenix King!
What a weird custom.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] tried to pass through the Flames of Asuryan, but the god saw his wickedness and burned him, sculpting a blasphemous shape around a blasphemous heart.
He cannot wear the crown!
He was burned for crossing a fire. So what?
Your [GetFromRelation] was burned by the holy Flames of Asuryan, disgracing his whole line along with himself.
But I'm not tainted!
The healing spells are slowly putting you back to health, but the scourge of Asuryan remains, marking your skin, weighing on your troubled soul.
How could this happen?
[From.GetTitledFirstName] tried to pass through the Flames of Asuryan, but the God saw his wickedness and burned him, leaving nothing but a blackened carcass in his wake.
A false king has been revealed by the righteous gods!
Why did he even cross the fire in the first place?
Your [GetFromRelation] was burned by the holy Flames of Asuryan, dying a horrible death and disgracing his whole bloodline.
But I'm not tainted!
You've been chosen by the Dragon Princes to take the lead of Ulthuan, following the disgraceful reign of [From.GetFirstName].
I will rule in the grace of Asuryan.
Following in the footsteps of the blasphemous Witch-King, [From.GetTitledFirstName] has renounced Asuryan to follow Kaela Mensha Khaine, planting the seeds for a potential second Sundering.
He is right!
Shame befalls him.
The Dragon Princes have decided that it is in the best interest of Ulthuan that its rule pass to [From.GetFirstName] after the ignominious departure of the last Phoenix King.
Some Elves believe the Asur should detach themselves from the corruption of the outside world, others that it is their duty to lead lesser species away from evil.
We need to protect Ulthuan.
We need to protect the World.

I am afraid the Faction I represent must insist on changing the current political stance of Ulthuan regarding the outside world. We are fully prepared to take up arms should you refuse, and rest assured, we have warriors enough to enforce our just demand and finally guarantee the safety and purity of the blood of Asur...

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]
Very well.
This is not what I command!

Your shameful attempt at blackmail has not succeeded. No matter how many corrupted souls you have enticed to help carry out your plan I will not give in without a fight. Ulthuan has been secluded for far too long!

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]
Then war it is!

I see the error of my ways and understand now what is best for the Asur. I will issue a formal declaration disallowing further interaction with the outside world.

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]
Excellent.

Rather than letting civil war tear the realm apart, [From.GetTitledName] has agreed to change [From.GetHerHis] stance on external politics. Your valuable support in this conflict will not be forgotten.

Sincerely,
[FromFrom.GetTitledName]
Good.
[From.GetTitledName] has agreed to the demands of the Isolationist Party.
I see...

I am afraid the Faction I represent must insist on changing the current political stance of Ulthuan regarding the outside world. We are fully prepared to take up arms should you refuse, and rest assured, we have warriors enough to enforce our just demand and finally lead Ulthuan beyond of this obnoxious stagnation.

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]
Very well.
This is not what I command!

Your shameful attempt at blackmail has not succeeded. No matter how many corrupted souls you have enticed to help carry out your plan I will not give in without a fight. Ulthuan needs not to meddle in the affairs of shortlived barbarians!

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]
Then war it is!

I see the error of my ways and understand now what is best for the Asur. I will issue a formal declaration allowing interactions with the outside world.

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]
Excellent.

Rather than letting civil war tear the realm apart, [From.GetTitledName] has agreed to change [From.GetHerHis] stance on external politics. Your valuable support in this conflict will not be forgotten.

Sincerely,
[FromFrom.GetTitledName]

Spectacular display of torture!
Finally the Asur prisoners your host has bought are presented to your guests. To great cheering, they are cruelly tortured and executed. Glory to Naggaroth!
To roaring laughs, a group of halfling jugglers are brought out. Large stones are passed out to the guests - the last halfling to remain juggling wins his life, the rest will be cruelly tortured!
Human hearts, and only the finest wines!
Regular fare will suffice - venison, cheese, and wine.
Fish, bread, and ale will suffice!
It's time to decide what you will serve your guests at the feast.
I haven't laughed so hard in ages!

To roaring laughs, a group of halfling slave jugglers your liege has purchased are brought out. Large stones are passed out to the guests - the last halfling to remain juggling wins his life, the rest will be cruelly tortured!
One of your guests comment loudly on how stunningly the sword dancer display was. Good, then they were well worth the money!
A band of outlaws is troubling your demesne, these should be cleared out so your highborn guests are assured safe travels to your feast.
A slave trader offers to sell you some prisoners from Ulthuan so that they can be sacrificed before the feast and grant Khaine's blessing to your endeavours.
Hah! I have to have this at my feast...
Funny, but no - we'll have to make do without them.
A slave trader offers to send you a group of halfling juggler slaves
column3: it will be most amusing he assures you. They juggle while stones are thrown at them, and only the last halfling to remain juggling is spared from ritual execution.

column2: I could have done just as well.

While on a border patrol, a servant won a great victory against a pack of marauding fiends. [From.GetSheHeCap] cut into their ranks, and put dozens of them to the sword. [From.GetSheHeCap] is truly blessed by the gods!
Imprison [From.GetHerHim]! I'll torture [From.GetHerHim] myself later...

While on a border patrol, a servant's warband was ambushed, but [From.GetSheHe] fled and left [From.GetHerHis] men to die! [From.GetSheHeCap] name is in disgrace, and [From.GetSheHe] has surely angered the gods with [From.GetHerHis] cowardice.
Yes, time to go home and put this wealth to good use.
Yes, time to go home and put this wealth to good use.
You have raided for a long time now and amassed great wealth. Perhaps it is time to stop, before your luck runs out?
Inform the crew - we bathe in blood tonight!
Inform the crew - we bathe in blood tonight!
Off the coast of the Old World one night you spot lights ahead
column3: it seems to be a small village. Do you want to go in and and pillage it?

column2: You silently sail up to the village, and then stealthily slip your warriors around it before unleashing a great war cry - the slaughter is glorious, and you take many slaves as captives!

You get your warband ashore, but as soon as you approach the village an alarm goes off, and worse still the militia are reinforced by a contingent of patrolling knights! Curses - this village is too heavily defended!
You come across a merchant convoy of human ships. There are three of them, but it looks like they are not warships. Prepare to board them?
Corsairs - full sail! Prepare for boarding action!
No, attacking three ships is too risky.
Bolt throwers, prepare to cut down their masts!
Damnation. Three on one, hardly favourable. Time to withdraw.
Spotting your sail, the ships turn towards you - brave fools, are they are actually going to try and fight you?
And they had a rich cargo too!

Your bolt throwers expertly disable the sails of two of the ships, leaving them dead in the water. Your crew board the other ship, and one by one, the others fall to. The sailors are cut down when they resist, with a choice selection of slaves picked from the 'lucky' survivors. This is a great victory!
Turn about, we'll outsail these scows!
Your bolt throwers failed to disable the approaching ships, and one of them carries a catapult which sends its own missiles your way. If one of them hits, it could be the end of you...
Prepare to repel boarders - bolt throwers, fire at will!
Curses! An Eagle Ship from Ulthuan has spotted your sail, and is fast approaching. You can't outrun the warship sent by your vile cousins, you'll have to try to repel their attack...
Your liege's court is crowded, and it's time to thin the herd. By getting rid of your competitors, your own favour in the eyes of your liege can only increase...
We claim their ship, it will fetch a good price.

Your cousins catch up to you but you managed to disable their bolt thrower with your own counter-strikes. A fierce boarding action ensues, but the hatred and ferocity of your crew overcomes the attempt, and soon the high elves are all dead, or fated for much worse...

A deadly shooting match ensues, you manage to do serious damage to their sails, but your own ship has been battered as well. It's time to attempt one last shot at their main mast, otherwise it looks like you won't be able to flee...
You have become wounded, and can no longer carry on the raiding life. It is time to return to your home and regain your strength.
Though temporarily defeated, you will never give up your claims to your ancestral homeland.
While working on one of your schemes, a rival at court has emerged. You will have to work towards destroying this individual before you yourself are destroyed!
Do not bother me with this again.
Court rumours say that one of your courtiers has gained a rival at court
column3: it should be interesting to see how this plays out in the future as they work towards foiling each other's schemes.

column2: A most excellent deal. Throw [From.GetHerHim] in the cells!
A most excellent deal. Throw [From.GetHerHim] in the cells!
A group of corsairs have captured a noble, and offer to sell him to you for a small fee. He is surely worth more than that in ransom... or else he would make a worthy sacrifice to Khaine?
W-wait... am I in... Naggaroth?
I'll get out... and when I do...
You pass out, and after days or weeks of fever dreams lying wounded on a ship somewhere, you wake up in a dark dungeon. Gods, where is this place, and why is it so dark and cold?
500 gold? Sounds like a bargain... Dwarf slaves live for at least 20 years.
500 gold? Sounds like a bargain... Dwarf slaves live for at least 20 years.
Do not bother me with this again.
Certainly, I shall return with slaves and plunder!
Certainly, I shall return with slaves and plunder!
You are a noble of Naggaroth, and you can outfit an expedition to go raiding abroad for the glory of Khaine and the Witch King. Do you wish to start looking for a ship and crew?
Curses! But hate will carry me on...

You have become maimed, and can no longer carry on the raiding life. It is time to return to your home, and let others lead from the front lines while you carefully manage your wealth and power from your court.

News have reached you [From.GetTitledFirstName] has started preparing a great invasion to reclaim Ulthuan. The wretched armies of corrupt Druchii raiders and witches gather already under [From.GetHerHis] banner.

News have reached you [From.GetTitledFirstName] has started preparing a great invasion to reclaim Ulthuan. The wretched armies of feeble Asur warriors and mages gather already under [From.GetHerHis] banner.
We must prepare.
We must prepare.

You've stalled for too long. Slowly, the forces you've gathered for your great invasion have lost their interest and fallen into petty squabbles for power, leaving you with no united force to wrestle Ulthuan from the wretched Asur.

You've stalled for too long. Slowly, the forces you've gathered for your great campaign of reconquest have lost their interest, thorn by debates regarding the validity of attacking now and leaving you with no united force to wrestle Ulthuan from the wretched Druchii.
Incompetent fools!
It'll be for another time...
A great host of raiders has gathered under your banner, they wait anxiously to set sail for Ulthuan.
A great host of warriors has gathered under your banner,they wait anxiously to set sail for Ulthuan.
Good.
A famous raider has come to your court, offering his allegiance and willingness to help you reclaim Ulthuan for a small share of the spoils.
A famous commander has come to your court, offering his allegiance and willingness to help you reclaim Ulthuan and deliver it from its corruption.
Good.
A small host of raiders has gathered under your banner, they wait anxiously to set sail for Ulthuan.
A small host of warriors has gathered under your banner, they wait anxiously to set sail for Ulthuan.
Good.
Your prisoner is thrown in the public pit and the cold one is released soon after. The creature growls and hisses at the victim for a while and then leaps forward, ripping them apart.
Who's hungry?
Your jailer has decided to punish you by tossing you in their pit and have a cold one devour you.
Aaah!!
Your prisoner is tied in the middle of the square, for all to see. At your call, the dragon comes down from above, burning them to a crisp and feasting on the remains.
Who's hungry?
Your jailer has decided to punish you by tossing you in their pit and have their dragon devour you.
Aaah!!

Your prisoner is tied in the middle of the square, for all to see. At your call, the griffon comes down from above, wrapping his claws around the body of the victim and starting to peel off skin with his beak, feasting while the prisoner is still alive and screaming.
Who's hungry?
Your jailer has decided to punish you by tossing you in their pit and have their Griffon devour you.
Aaah!!

And so it has come to pass that not a man but a woman trained in the arcane arts defeated the Witch King. For centuries Malekith forbade men from practising magic under his lands, needlessly fearing for a prophecy which is clear now he so greatly misunderstood. This is a great day for the Asur, as their greatest enemy has been defeated and the remaining Druchii will soon fight amongst themselves for his legacy.

And so it has come to pass that a mage defeated the Witch King, just as Caledor prophesied. For centuries Malekith forbade men from practising magic under his lands, but in the end there was nothing he could do to avoid his destiny. This is a great day for the Asur, as their greatest enemy has been defeated and the remaining Druchii will soon fight amongst themselves for his legacy.

And so it has come to pass that a commoner defeated the Witch King. For centuries Malekith forbade men from practising magic under his lands, fearing the a mage would have been born and trained in the arcane art, become more powerful than him and destroy him, like Caledor prophesied. Yet, in the end, it was through mundane means that the Witch King of Naggaroth found his end. This is a great day for the Asur, as their greatest enemy has been defeated and the remaining Druchii will soon fight amongst themselves for his legacy.
A great accomplishment.
The Witch King dies...

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has grown weary of the squabbling of [From.GetHerHis] subjects. Unleashing [From.GetHerHis] host of spies and informants, [From.GetSheHe] is surveying Naggaroth to cut down any attempt at insurrection. You, as well as your supporters, have decided it might be best to dissolve your factions for now.
Our time will come again.
You've discovered another amongst your servants, [From.GetTitledFirstName], who thought he could secretely practice the dark arts to grow more powerful than you and kill you.
There is no doubt about it: your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] shows the gift of a sorcerer-to-be. Why else would he have hid this from you if not to plot against your throne?
I shall not die by your sorcery!
The prophecy must not be fulfilled. Not even by you, my son.

The Witch-King discovered of your meddling with the dark arts and has quickly sent his best assassins to deal with you. Before you can even react, the shadowy druchii sink their blades in your back time and again.
Hhhggghhh...
All able-bodied young Naggarothi are expected to serve the Witch King in the Black Guard army for a hundred-years draft.
I will ask permission to my liege.

All able-bodied young Naggarothi are expected to serve the Witch King in the Black Guard army for a hundred-years draft. [From.GetFirstName] has reached the proper age, the officers from Naggarond will soon come to take [From.GetHerHim].
Very well.
I can convince them to do otherwise.
[From.GetFirstName] has not opposed the Witch King's edict. It is time for you to depart and join the Black Guard.
[From.GetFirstName] has used bribes and threats against the Naggarondi officiers to prevent you from leaving court. It seems you shall avoid the draft entirely.
I see.

Your draft has finally come to an end. In this years you've come to trust and rely on the men of your regiment, will you abandon them to resume your duties as a Naggarothi nobleman or will you stay in the Black Guard forever?
I will stay.
Enough of this.
Your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] has decided that he will never return, taking his place as a Black Guard permanently in the army of the Witch King.
So be it.
The training in the army is no less cutthroat than the rest of druchii society. Sadly it appears you did not have what it takes to be a Black Guard.
No!
Your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] has felt the call of Khaine and decided to become a Witch Elf. As Khaine is a jealous god, she won't be able to marry anyone else.
Very well.
I won't allow this.

You have devoted yourself to the Lord of Murder, giving away your possessions and proclaiming yourself to be his bride. In these following years you shall train and learn the rites and secrets of the Witches, so that you may better serve your master.
For Khaine!

Years have passed, but, despite your fervor, you were judged lacking in the eyes of the Lord of Murder. A Khainite Assassin has been sent to dispose of you and, as the lights go out, you are made aware in a cold whisper that you have failed your god.
Hghhh.

For years you have trained and bathed in the blood of your enemies, offering their beating hearts at the altar of Khaine. The Lord of Murder looks favourably upon you and the other Witch Elves have come to see you as a respected member of their coven.
As they should.
No mercy and no love. The Lord of Murder beckons death and suffering and in the rivers of blood shed in his honor, you cannot feel anything but excitement and anticipation.
Their screams are like music.
The horrors and peril in the church of Khaine have ironed your soul and sharpened your senses. You no longer feel fear.
Only you should be afraid.
The constant strain of the savage rituals and the blood-soaked campaigns have made you stronger and faster than the ordinary elf. Few can hold their own against you in a duel.
Their blood for my strength!
Khaine rules over death, none can escape his grasp, neither the greatest warrior nor the wisest sorcerer, all pay tribute to the Lord of Murder in the end.
For Khaine!
Working with blades and daggers day and night can certainly leave the mark.
Each scar brings glory to Khaine.

All Witches are Khaine's brides. He is a jealous god and does not tolerate any man to touch them. Yet, you've found there's another kind of solace to be found in his halls, warmer and softer than what the god's statue can provide.
Hmm.
Through discipline and training, your mind resonates, touched by the sublime designs of the Lord of Murder, and opens to new strategies and dreams of slaughter.
Show me the way.

In the frenzy of last night's ritual, some of your sisters were overcome by Khaine's bloodlust and attacked you. Unable to resist to all of them, you barely managed to survive, albeit seriously wounded.
Grrnpfh!
Death and blood course through your veins, you can hear Khaine's voice whispering to you, telling you of his next victims, sharpening your will and senses.
I'm ready to do your bidding, o Lord of Murder.

The Witch Elves come at night, silent and deadly, but it is not your blood they seek. Snatched from your palace, you're brought shrieking at the Alter of Khaine and baptised in blood. You shall live with the brides of the Lord of Murder and become an Assassin.

Your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] has been kidnapped! The Witch Elves sneaked in at night and took the infant from [From.GetHerHis] crib. Though many children do not survive in the church of Khaine, [From.GetFirstName] might be skilled and blessed enough to do so and grow into a deadly Assassin.
For the glory of Khaine.
Tha big bad beasty goz down an' eatz dead the bad boy. Makes other bad boyz turn good and tha' why good Bosses have big beasties.
Rumpfh.
Your brutish captor has decided to feed you to his ravenous pet wyvern.
Aaargh!!
Dragon Eater
In Naggaroth, a Dragon egg is naught but a potential source of power. It can be consumed so that the devourer obtains a portion of its strength, or kept to gain a fearsome mount in the future.
This power shall be mine
On second thoughts, this is clearly a waste of a dragon.
Dragonrider

The black dragons of Naggarond are fearsome creatures, and with a decade to spare, money, and enough prestige, it will be possible to acquire a black dragon egg and raise it up to serve as your mount.
A Dragonrider I shall be
On seconds thoughts, maybe a cold one would suffice
The Egg Hatches

A year has passed, and your dragon egg has hatched. The newborn rears its wings and attempts a mighty roar, but instead just mewls like a newborn babe. In nine years your dragon should be fully grown and ready to battle by your side.
A way to go yet...
I no longer possess a black dragon egg
Dragon Rising
Nine years have passed and your dragon has finally reached maturity. Having bonded with you and been trained for battle, you now have a mount that will make your enemies flee before you in terror.
I hope they fail their leadership tests
I no longer possess a black dragon hatchling
A Powerful Inheritance
I have come into possession of a Black Dragon Egg. I could keep possession of it or sell it for a quick profit.
I better keep hold of something this powerful
Sell it
A Powerful Inheritance
I have come into possession of a Black Dragon Hatchling. I could keep possession of it or sell it for a quick profit.
I better keep hold of something this powerful
Sell it
There are a large variety of beers available at the feast. You have already had five flagons, it may be a good idea to stop drinking...
And I will drink five flagons more!
I am a Dwarf, not a drunkard!
Your miners have found a rich vein of high quality gold ore which the miners have eagerly started to work on.
What a pleasant surprise!

A confused Dwarf has been found strolling around in the caves beneath [Capital.GetName]. He asks for your permission to stay at your court until he remembers who he was before and where he comes from.
You can stay
I got more important things to worry about.
An Old Tradition.

Masonry is an old Dwarf tradition. Compared to the other lesser races, it is highly sophisticated and very respected. A Dwarf mason does not only work with building residential areas but they also are the ones who have the honourable task of building the huge halls and intriguing chambers that cover most of the Dwarf Karaks. As these structures are some of the most magnificent in the known world so are the Dwarf masons rightfully regarded as the best masons in the world which they are fully aware of and find great pride in. Masonry isn't just a way to build their homes, it is an art form.
Glory to the Dwarfs!
You have tried to make a small statue of a Dwarf warrior. Despite the fact it barely resembles a Dwarf and the axe is way too small, it is still an improvement since before.
A good attempt
Your attempt at making a small statue of a Dwarf warrior failed miserably. Halfway through you accidentally broke the statue which probably didn't matter as the statue would have looked awful anyway.
What a disappointment.
There is a very rough wall in one the watchtowers in [Capital.GetName] which you have decided to smooth out. The wall actually ended up quite smooth even though there are some scratches in it.
A good attempt
There is a very rough wall in one of your watchtowers in [Capital.GetName] which you have decided to smooth out.But the wall ended up looking even worse than it was before and very unstable.
We will have to rebuild the wall then...
You have decided to join your masons in their daily work, you learnt a lot of new stuff and you are very confident that you can put that practice to the test.
Very interesting
You have decided to join your masons in their daily work. they carefully gave you some tips, but you had a very tough time understanding what they meant so you did not learn that much.
What a shame
You have decided to smooth out the very uneven floor in the throne room. The floor actually ended up quite smooth so you are mighty pleased with yourself now.
I am not that bad of a mason after all!
You have lately been smoothing out a rough part of floor in the throne room, but it ended in a complete disaster and you wouldn't be surprised if the floor is even more uneven now than before.
I am so ashamed of myself...
Your skills in masonry have improved significantly. You are now at the level of your own masons. Considering how good Dwarfs are at masonry it is quite an achievement!
I am now a fully fledged mason!
You decided a while back to engrave the pillars in your throne room, that you have now finally finished. The elaborate runes cover most of the pillars that stand firmly in your throne room.
Well done, [Root.GetName]!

You decided some time ago to engrave the pillars in your throne room. But you have at several points in the engraving accidentally left large cracks in the pillars so you sadly need to build new ones.
Well that's annoying!
You have for the last weeks been working on rebuilding the entrance to the castle as the entrance was very battered. The entrance now looks sturdier than ever before which pleases you enormously.
Well done, [Root.GetName]!
While repairing the castle's entrance, it accidentally collapsed in on itself so you have been forced to reinforce the garrison with a couple of sellswords to guard the entrance in the meantime.
How unfortunate!
The reparations of the castles battlements have gone far better than expected, the battlements are not only stronger but also considerably more redoubtable!
That will ward off any attackers
The widening of the castle's battlements has not gone as planned as it ended up being very unstable and it has collapsed at some points along the wall. A complete rebuild of the walls is necessary.
Oh oh...
Your rival deserves to feel pain and what better way to make someone feel pain than to destroy what that person loves. In this case it is your rivals statues...
Say goodbye to your statues!
No, that is below me
One morning when you come down to your statue workshop you suddenly see most of the statues have been crushed by some heavy tool. Several years of work now lie shattered on the floor.
MY STATUES!!!

[From.GetTitledName] has finally felt the pain that [From.GetSheHe] deserves. Rumours say that [From.GetSheHe] is devastated by [From.GetHerHis] loss and you can't stop yourself from grinning at the news.
I am so sneaky!
The road network in one of your provinces is severely lacking after a small flood which destroyed most of the bridges. But you and your masons might be able to rebuild them again...
And we will build them even better this time
I wasn't planning on travelling there anyway
You haven't thought for a long time about creating a statue of one of three most important of the Ancestral Gods - Valaya, Grimnir or Grungni. But who will you choose?
Grimnir, the warrior!
Grungni, the smith!
Valaya, the protector!
I don't believe in Gods!
Your hated rival can finally pay the final price which is nothing less than your rival's death! You have been thinking about a masterful plan involving some highly unstable mining tunnels...
REVENGE!!!
I am not a murderer...
To succeed with your plan you must first find a tunnel that is highly unstable and one that would collapse at a seconds notice. And of course, you also must get your rival to the spot...
The sweet taste of revenge!
While walking around in the tunnels you suddenly get interrupted by a loud rumbling sound. You begin to run back and you barely manage to get away from the tunnel before it collapses.
That was to close!
While walking around in the tunnels you suddenly get interrupted by a loud rumbling sound. You begin to run back but you don't get far before a huge rock falls down upon you, killing you immediately.
Noooooo!
The plan was a failure. [From.GetName] managed to escape in time barely avoiding the large pieces of rock falling from the celling.
What a shame
Your plan was a success! The falling boulders crushed [From.GetName], killing [From.GetHerHim] instantly.
I am so good at intrigue
You have put your masonry skills to the test and started building a completely new mining system in one of your provinces and it ended up very successfully.
Excellent
You are now a masterful mason! There are few limits to what you can and cannot build and other Dwarfs often look upon you with envy in their eyes.
Sounds exciting!
You have lately been working on improving your throne room's engravings and you can't stop yourself from being very pleased with the result.
A wonderful throne room made by a wonderful [Root.GetManWoman]!
You have for a long time thought about making a large statue of yourself and then put that statue in some place where everyone can see it, like the entrance for example.
I am worthy of the honour!
Pride goes before fall
This was a one time thing
The Human beer served to you was nowhere near the taste of Dwarf beer, almost making you vomit. You feel a big urge to tell them exactly what you feel about their so called beer!
Are you trying to poison me, manling!?
I guess I better get used to the taste...
You have recently invited the Dwarf [From.GetName] for a drink or two in your chamber but when [From.GetSheHe] tried it [From.GetSheHe] immediately started complaining about the beverages served.
No we DO NOT have Dwarf beer here so stop complaining!
I think you will like my Dwarf beer more...
I should have bought some Dwarf beer before I invited [From.GetHerHim] over
[From.GetName] got very angry when I voiced my opinion about the awful Human beer served and [From.GetSheHe] dismissed me with all of the needed courtesy.
Hah, weak Manlings!
When you voiced your opinion on the colored water that the Humans call beer [From.GetSheHe] gave you some Dwarf beer instead. The conversation continued on smoothly with the help of a beer or two...
Nothing can beat Dwarf beer!
Is it the Manlings who keep the Orcs at bay? Are the Elflings famous for their engineering? No, it is the Dwarfs and only Dwarfs who can do that and we should be proud of that!
We are glorious!
Pride goes before fall

An ordinary part in a "regular" Dwarf's life is the regular visit to the local tavern to both drink the excellent beer served but to also spend some time with friends. But you are no "regular" Dwarf right?
I should not let my responsibilities weigh me down!
I think I will skip this time
I don't have any time for that. Because I got work to do!
Making An Entrance

The first things that enter your mind when you walk through the door into the cosy little tavern are the constant laughters and the singing from a dozen drunken Dwarfs on the right side of the tavern. To the left a couple of human merchants sit, trying out the Dwarf beer for the first time with several loud exclamations in their foreign tongue. Most other seats have already been taken by the Dwarf miners who just ended their mining shift and are now eager to have a drink, except for the seats far in the corner to the left who are almost completely covered in shadows. You take some fast steps forward but slow down when you realise that you don't know where to sit.
I will sit by myself
I have always wanted to know humans better
I will go and join the singing Dwarfs at their table
Suddenly a longbearded Dwarf with several large scars enters the tavern. He scans the room with his watchul eyes before he starts to walk towards your table. "May I join?" he asks.
Sure
Come up with some plausible excuse for saying no
The veteran tells you some of the most fascinating stories of his adventures. But he also says that he has grown tired of adventuring and wants to settle down. Maybe you could offer him that?
Welcome!
I don't think that would be a good idea
When you sit by yourself and have nothing to do except for drinking, it is quite hard to resist drinking. Dwarfs can drink a lot without even flinching but there is a limit...
Who can resist proper Dwarf beer!
I am a Dwarf, not a drunkard!
Suddenly one of your courtiers appears and sits down at your table. You talk to each other till sunrise even though you barely manage to not fall asleep. Will you contact the courtier again?
It was a one time thing
We should do that again, my friend!
It doesn't take long for the human traders to try to sell you something. In this case it is a book which they claim comes from one of the lost Dwarf holds.
I will buy it
It is obviously a fraud
The book you bought has now been confirmed to be a real one, coming from a hold which must have been destroyed such a long time ago so that no one even knows it's name.
And it contains some very interesting knowledge
The book you bought is a Dwarf book but instead of containing lost knowledge it is a badly written romantic fiction.
Those humans will pay!
The humans tells you the most fascinating stories about their homeland, giving you a further understanding about how the world is outside your hold. Because that was the truth wasn't it?
Very interesting
The humans are the representatives of a rich merchant who wants to set up trade with one of the Dwarf holds on a large scale.
I think we can come up with something profitable for both of us!
It seems like the humans were not merchants but instead debt collectors wanting to get their debt paid. You talked to them for a while before excusing yourself.
I wonder where they are going
The Dwarfs were an active bunch singing and drinking without any end in sight.
We are having a great time!
You easily take part in their festivities with a wide smile on your face and you think that you have become friends with one of them.
I will never forget this day
The drunken Dwarfs have challenged you to a drinking competition, will you accept or not?
Of course I will accept it!
No, I got to work tomorrow
You easily out-drink your opponent and claim the price!
Beer! *belch* I LOVE BEEEEEER!
Your opponent drinks five flagons in a matter of seconds even though he must have drunk several flagons already.
And now I have to pay for all of the beer...
The night at the tavern is finally over so you slowly drag yourself home awaiting the terrible hangover that will soon hit you with the force of a bull.
What a night!
Your beard has now grown so long so that you are no longer seen as a beardling but as a fully grown man. But as a lord so are you expected to enlist in the army, but what regiment will you fight in?
The crossbow-armed Quarrellers!
The Dwarf warriors!
The handgun-armed Thunderers!
Fighting?! Sounds dangerous...
Training Begins

The quarrellers are powerful missile troops that use their crossbows to kill the enemy at range. The bolts that the crossbow fires may not have the armor penetration of the handguns but they have a superior range instead which can prove many times even more deadly than the handguns. Fighting in a disciplined manner,firing volley after volley with the high precision that the crossbow is so famous for and so they are righteously feared by their enemies and awed by their allies. You are their lord but they will still not allow you to join their ranks if they consider you unworthy. The training is mostly ceremonial as most Dwarfs that join the quarrellers already know how to use a crossbow but that does not make it any less important to not fail.

The Dwarf warriors are the bulk of the Dwarf military might, locked in a hand-to-hand combat with the enemy. Fighting in their famous shieldwall formations, these fierce opponents are close to unstoppable if they manage to keep their formation intact. EVTDESC_chaos_dwarf_great_taurus;Most of the Great Tauruses in the plains of Zharrduk come from the breeding pens under the temple of Hashut in Zharr-Naggrund. While most of the beasts there are fully grown, it takes time for the Chaos Dwarf Sorcerers to attune the beast's binding enchantments to a new rider. These rituals will be completed in 5 years.;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTDESCB_chaos_dwarf_great_taurus;Outside of the plains of Zharrduk, the Great Tauruses can only be found in their natural habitats, inside the calderas of active volcanoes. You have managed to convince one of the Bull Centaurs guarding [From.Capital.GetName]'s temple to snatch a young calf from one of the nearby volcanoes. The beast will be fully grown and magically bound in 5 years.;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTOPTA_chaos_dwarf_great_taurus;Excellent;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTDESC_chaos_dwarf_great_taurus_trained;Finally, the Great Taurus is tamed, the magical beast's binding enchantments fully attuned so that it obeys your will completely. The Great Tauruses are considered by the Chaos Dwarfs to be the living images of Hashut, great, winged bulls surrounded by a wreathing aura of infernal flame.;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTOPTA_chaos_dwarf_great_taurus_trained;On wings of fire and smoke I soar!;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTDESC_chaos_dwarf_lamassu;Only the Sorcerer-Prophets of Hashut have the magical prowess to master a Lammasu as their mount. But these beasts cannot be binded by magic alone, like the Great Tauruses. Lammasus are cunning, intelligent beasts, and must as well be bargained within order to be completely mastered, for not even the Dawi Zharr would dare mount a Lammasu without pacting with it before. The process to find, convince and master a Lammasu will take 5 years.;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTOPTA_chaos_dwarf_lamassu;Excellent;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTDESC_chaos_dwarf_lamassu_trained;Finally, the Lammasu has been brought down to your service, through equal parts of deceit and magical skill. The Lammasus are beasts of insidious cunning, resembling Great Tauruses in it's bovine body, leathery wings and back quarters, but with clawed forelimbs and an eerie bearded, and horned face, resembling a Chaos Dwarf in many ways.;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTOPTA_chaos_dwarf_lamassu_trained;Hashut favours me!;;;;;;;;;;;;x

EVTDESCBchaosdwarf_slave_raid;The province of [From.GetName] has been raided and burned to the ground by our great hosts. Most of your overseers are on their way to [Root.Capital.GetName], herding the slaves you previously captured in another assault, but your personal entourage can still herd a small quantity of them...;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTDESC_chaos_dwarf_must_sacrifice;For too long have the furnaces at [Root.Capital.GetName] remained silent and devoid of any kind of offering. You have gone 4 years without a proper sacrifice to Hashut. The Father of Darkness does not look kindly upon those who fail to pay Him tribute...;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTOPTC_chaos_dwarf_must_sacrifice;I'm sure the Bullfather doesn't mind...;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTDESC_hashut_great_sacrifice;The acolytes of Hashut have prepared the furnaces at the top of [Root.Capital.GetName]'s ziggurat for your grand sacrifice ceremony by chanting the sacred dirges. Now is the time, to offer the souls of slaves and wretches to the Bullfather, so that our Lord Hashut may feast on them.\n\nThe temple's Bull Centaurs look to you with anticipation, ready to retrieve the next sacrifice at your command...;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTOPTA_hashut_great_sacrifice;Herd in slaves from the factories!;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTOPTB_hashut_great_sacrifice;Bring the wretches that form our slave levies!;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTOPTC_hashut_great_sacrifice;Our prisoners shall have the honour to become sacrifice!;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTOPTD_hashut_great_sacrifice;I've changed my mind! Hashut doesn't deserve any gifts!;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTDESC_hashut_great_sacrifice_prisoner;Your watch gleefully as the Bull Centaurs drag [From.GetTitledFirstName] up the stairs of the ziggurat, towards the great, brazen statue of Hashut, a pool of molten metal beneath it acts as it's furnace. As the Bull Centaur places [From.GetHerHim] close to the furnace, you hear the mumblings of a prayer to [From.Religion.GetHighGodName].\n\n[From.GetFirstName] tries to keep a stoic composure... but it soon fades into agony as [From.GetSheHe] is submerged into the molten metal...;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTDESC_hashut_great_sacrifice_character_blessing;As the last of the sacrifice's laments echo through the chamber... you feel that your body is now strong as a Bull Centaur's and your mind is quick as a Daemon's... certainly, you have been blessed by the Bullfather!;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTDESC_hashut_great_sacrifice_province_blessing;As the last of the sacrifice's laments echo through the chamber... you don't notice any changes, at first, but when you step out of the Zigurrat's ceremonal changer you notice that your whole land has been covered in a thick, red smoke which seems to be unnaturally empowering your forges and slaves, certainly [Root.Capital.GetName] has been blessed by the Bullfather!;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTDESC_hashut_great_sacrifice_bull_centaurs_join;As the last of the sacrifice's laments echo through the chamber... you don't see any changes, at first, but when you step out of the Zigurrat's ceremonal changer you notice that a small regiment of Bull Centaurs is waiting at it's feet, willing to serve you! Clearly, this is Father Hashut's providence gracing us!;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTDESC_hashut_great_sacrifice_hashut_angry;As the last of the sacrifice's laments echo through the chamber... you notice a cloud of red smoke forming in front of you, in a wink, it quickly files towards you and forces itself down your throat, making you pass out... when you awake, you're informed by the temple's Acolytes that you must have somehow earned Hashut's wrath, and indeed, you feel much weaker...;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTOPT_hashut_great_sacrifice_hashut_angry;Curses!;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTDESC_hashut_great_sacrifice_slaves;Your watch gleefully as the Bull Centaurs herd in masses of slaves up the stairs of the ziggurat, towards the great, brazen statue of Hashut, a pool of molten metal beneath it acts as it's furnace. As the Bull Centaur places them close to the furnace, you hear multiple mumbles and whimpers coming from the wretches.\n\nThey're pushed one by one into the pool of molten metal, their anguished laments forming a wonderful choir...;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTOPT_hashut_great_sacrifice_slaves;Mighty Hashut! Accept the slave blood and slave flesh we offer thee!;;;;;;;;;;;;x

EVTDESCDR_chaos_dwarf.41;The Bullfather is pleased with your offering. As your sacrifice dissolves into the molten metal pit, you hear a booming voice coming from the brazen idol's head...offering you gifts;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTOPTADR_chaos_dwarf.41;Grant me some of your fiery K'daai servants, to sear my enemies!;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTOPTBDR_chaos_dwarf.41;Mighty Hashut, bless me with your strength!;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTOPTCDR_chaos_dwarf.41;Great Hashut, touch my lands with your fire!;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTOPTDDR_chaos_dwarf.41;Bullfather, grant me greater dominion over the Winds!;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTDESCDR_chaos_dwarf.42;The Bullfather must be pleased with you, for after your sacrifice dissolves into the molten pit, a daemonic creature of fire and steel surges from it, pledging itself to your service;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTOPTADR_chaos_dwarf.42;Bend to my will, daemon!;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTDESCDR_chaos_dwarf43;As your sacrifice sinks into the molten metal, you hear a bellowing in the outside. Hashut has sent you a Great Taurus, one of his most favoured creatures!;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTOPTADR_chaos_dwarf43;I will soar on wings of fire!;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTDESCDR_chaos_dwarf44;The Bullfather is pleased. You watch as the molten metal takes into different shapes and forms... showing images of yourself surrounded by power and riches!;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTOPTADR_chaos_dwarf44;It will all be mine!;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTDESCDR_chaos_dwarf45;As the sacrifice sinks into the molten pit you hear the booming voice of Hashut in your head, praising you... His greatest [This.GetSonDaughter]!;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTOPTADR_chaos_dwarf45;All will bow before me!;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTDESCDR_chaos_dwarf46;After the sacrifice sinks into the molten metal pit, you receive visions of yourself... a crown of fire is on your brows, burning... burning, until naught but ash remains...;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTOPTADR_chaos_dwarf46;Why? What is the meaning of this?!;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTDESCDR_chaos_dwarf47;As the sacrifice sinks into the molten pit you get closer to it, in order to receive your gift... when suddenly a gush of molten metal sprays you in the face;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTOPTADR_chaos_dwarf47;AAAAGH!!;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTDESCDR_chaos_dwarf48;At last the sacrifice dissolves into the molten pit of metal... and the ritual room is filled with a most dire silence. It seems that the Bullfather has ignored your offering!;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTOPTADR_chaos_dwarf48;Hashut's balls!;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTDESCDR_chaos_dwarf49;Praise Mighty Hashut! After all the sacrifices and absolute servitude, the Bullfather has finally granted you His greatest of gifts: dominion over the Winds of Magic! Soon the whole world will be under your yoke, for now, you're one of the great, magnificent masters of the Dawi Zharr, a Sorcerer-Prophet!;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTOPTADR_chaos_dwarf49;ALL FOR HASHUT!;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTDESCDR_chaos_dwarf_kdaai_summoned;The K'daai slowly takes form before you, a creature of magma and iron, half-daemon and half-raging fire. The circle holds and the daemon is yours to command.;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTOPTADR_chaos_dwarf_kdaai_summoned;I am your Master now.;;;;;;;;;;;;x
